entry.title: Almas Tower
entry.note: Source-local map frame binds the primary plan to eight mapped podium tips. The largest diamond-exchange petal points northeast, the lower ellipse lies north, and the tall southern ellipse carries the mast at its clipped right end. Published64×42 m shaft dimensions override the malformed map shaft outline. GroundY0 is the tower/podium entry datum; below-grade cascading landscape is outside this model. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
